slides.title: Introduction
slides.content:
# Flask 🌶️

Micro web framework!

```python
from flask import Flask

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/')
def home():
    return 'Hello, Flask!'

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(debug=True)
```

> 💡 **Flask is lightweight** - add only what you need!
